Name: Order cycle time
Denominator: Fully received noncancelled orders in intake cohort
Exclusions_and_limitations: Cancelled and incomplete orders excluded; final partial receipt completes order. Survivorship bias: disclose 51 open noncancelled orders.
Date_basis: Intake cohort 2026-07-01 through 2026-10-11; snapshot 2026-10-11; calendar days; dates interpreted as UK business-local dates
Business_target: Unresolved; synthetic baseline is not a target

Name: On-time delivery %
Formula: 100 × orders fully received by initial confirmed receipt date / orders with initial promise due by as-of
Denominator: Noncancelled orders with nonblank initial_confirmed_receipt_date ≤ as-of
Exclusions_and_limitations: Open overdue and partially fulfilled overdue orders fail; future promises excluded; unknown promise excluded and counted separately. Do not substitute requested date.
Date_basis: Intake cohort 2026-07-01 through 2026-10-11; snapshot 2026-10-11; calendar days; dates interpreted as UK business-local dates
Business_target: Unresolved; synthetic baseline is not a target

Name: Order fulfilment rate %
Denominator: All noncancelled orders in intake cohort, including open and future-due
Exclusions_and_limitations: Cancelled excluded; partial contributes received units only; dispatched but not received does not count. Mixed products all use EA but units have unequal value.
Date_basis: Intake cohort 2026-07-01 through 2026-10-11; snapshot 2026-10-11; calendar days; dates interpreted as UK business-local dates
Business_target: Unresolved; synthetic baseline is not a target

Name: Billing cycle time
Denominator: Invoiced deliveries with goods issue by as-of
Exclusions_and_limitations: Unbilled deliveries excluded from mean but disclosed separately; partial deliveries measured individually; net cancellations/reversals absent from data. Not dispatch-to-billing time.
Date_basis: Intake cohort 2026-07-01 through 2026-10-11; snapshot 2026-10-11; calendar days; dates interpreted as UK business-local dates
Business_target: Unresolved; synthetic baseline is not a target

Name: Order error rate %
Formula: 100 × distinct orders with validation_error event / received orders
Denominator: All 300 orders in intake cohort including later cancellations
Exclusions_and_limitations: Corrected errors still count once; open/partial/cancelled included. Does not measure undetected or invoice errors.
Date_basis: Intake cohort 2026-07-01 through 2026-10-11; snapshot 2026-10-11; calendar days; dates interpreted as UK business-local dates
Business_target: Unresolved; synthetic baseline is not a target

Name: Manual-touch rate %
Formula: 100 × distinct orders with manual_touch event / received orders
Denominator: All 300 orders in intake cohort including later cancellations
Exclusions_and_limitations: Includes chase, rekey and handoff enquiry, excludes routine physical picks; multiple touches count once. Logging completeness and process stage affect rate.
Date_basis: Intake cohort 2026-07-01 through 2026-10-11; snapshot 2026-10-11; calendar days; dates interpreted as UK business-local dates
Business_target: Unresolved; synthetic baseline is not a target
